description: A seed is a 128-bit value (std::array<uint8_t, 16>). It is the single root of trust for an account's keys: the same seed deterministically regenerates the same key pair.

description: generateSeed(passphrase) = first 128 bits of SHA512-Half of the passphrase string. No salt, no stretching, no iteration count.
tree_evidence: include/xrpl/protocol/Seed.h:100-113 (doc: first 128 bits of SHA512-Half); src/libxrpl/protocol/Seed.cpp:76-83

description: parseGenericSeed tries, in order: reject if the string parses as an account/public/secret key; hex 128-bit; Base58 family seed; RFC1751 English words; otherwise falls back to generateSeed(passphrase). Any string is therefore a valid seed input.
quantum_relevance: high — recovery is passphrase-only; there is no on-ledger recovery or escrow

description: seedAs1751 encodes a seed as RFC1751 English words (reversed byte order); toBase58 encodes it as a family seed token (starts with 's'). Both are human-copyable backup formats.
quantum_relevance: high — the backup format IS the secret; anyone holding the words holds the keys

description: generateSecretKey(ed25519, seed) = SHA512-Half of the 16-byte seed, used directly as the 32-byte secret key.
quantum_relevance: high — 128-bit seed entropy caps Ed25519 key security at 128 bits

description: A custom family derivation: deriveDeterministicRootKey(seed) gives a root key; Generator derives the nth key pair by a SHA512-Half tweak (generator || seq || subseq counter) added to the root secret. Predates BIP-32/BIP-44; not required for interop.
quantum_relevance: high — one seed yields a whole family of keys; all fall together

description: generateKeyPair(type, seed) is deterministic (same seed, same keys); randomKeyPair(type) draws a fresh 32-byte secret from the CSPRNG and derives the public key. Default key type is Ed25519 where the caller does not specify.
quantum_relevance: high — determinism is what makes seed backup work

description: derivePublicKey: secp256k1 via secp256k1_ec_pubkey_create + compressed serialization (33 bytes, 0x02/0x03 prefix); Ed25519 via ed25519_publickey with a 0xED prefix byte (33 bytes total).

description: KeyType has exactly two values (secp256k1 = 0, ed25519 = 1). publicKeyType() dispatches on the 33-byte serialized key: 0xED = Ed25519, 0x02/0x03 = secp256k1, anything else = no type.
quantum_relevance: high — no post-quantum key type exists in the dispatch

description: calcAccountID = RIPEMD-160(SHA-256(public key)). The 160-bit address hides the public key until the account first transacts.
quantum_relevance: high — never-transacted accounts are hidden; first transaction exposes the key

description: sign(): Ed25519 = ed25519_sign, always 64 bytes; secp256k1 = ECDSA over SHA512-Half of the message with RFC6979 nonces, DER-serialized 70-72 bytes. signDigest() is secp256k1-only.

description: verify(): Ed25519 via ed25519_sign_open after stripping the 0xED prefix (with canonical-signature check); secp256k1 via verifyDigest over SHA512-Half. checkSingleSign verifies over txSign-prefixed data; checkMultiSign over txMultiSign-prefixed data; a transaction cannot be both single- and multi-signed.

description: SetRegularKey sets sfRegularKey on the account's AccountRoot; a regular key signs on behalf of the account. lsfDisableMaster (0x00100000) forces regular-key-only signing. Setting the regular key to the account itself is rejected when fixMasterKeyAsRegularKey is enabled.

description: SetSignerList creates/replaces/destroys a SignerList ledger entry (ltSIGNER_LIST, 0x0053) with a quorum and weighted signer entries (Account + SignerWeight + WalletLocator).
